notes.title: LOOTPLOT: The COOL Update 8)
notes.content:
Tonnes of changes!

- 3 new starting items
- New items
- Rebalancing of existing slots/items
- Added sapphire slot
- Reworked diamond, gold, ruby slots
- Simplified tutorial
- Added 3 new backgrounds
- Added unlocks for backgrounds and starting-items
- Tonnes of small QoL fixes and balancing

For more information, join the discord. 
I am active there, and I want to hear your feedback/feelings about the game.

notes.title: BETA v0.0.1
notes.content:
- Balance changes!
- Added a tonne of new items, and "GRUBBY" system.
- Fixed many bugs
